findings: All 9 merges serve G1–G3 in priority order. I checked what the diffs claim against /repo/tpatzelt.github.io at HEAD b49ae0f, and `bash scripts/check-site.sh` prints `check-site: OK` (rc=0).

G1 looks done. background.js and the .floating-shapes/.shape blobs are deleted, the pointer parallax is removed from main.js, and main.js itself was later deleted. The page is now near-white (#faf9f6) with near-black text (#16161a), one accent (#3a5a9c) and Inter only. Checks 9 and 10 stop the old background and the cat cursor from being linked again.

G1 leftovers: assets/js/cat-cursor.js, assets/css/cat-cursor.css and assets/walking_cat_sprite.png are no longer referenced but are still in the repo. The hero is still a centered 100vh block with a monospace '# machine_learning_engineer' ::before label and a monospace role line. That is a trace of the old landing-page style rather than the reference's editorial type. Small polish, not drift.

G2 looks done. About, Selected work and Contact sit below the hero. Work renders from _data/projects.yml and Contact from _data/contact.yml. All biography is clearly marked placeholder text, so nothing is invented. Tim still needs to supply: the About statement, and real project titles, summaries, years, URLs and tags.
Minor bug risk in T-0015: the Liquid variable `href` is not reset on each loop pass. A contact.yml entry with an unknown `kind` would silently reuse the previous link's URL. None exists today.

G3 mostly holds. Exactly one h1, headings in order (h1, then h2, then h3), a :focus-visible outline on a/button/summary, and a universal reduced-motion rule that turns off transitions, animations and smooth scroll. T-0017 swapped `overflow-x: hidden` for `overflow-wrap: anywhere`. Its guard (check 15) only greps for 100vw and fixed widths, so nothing actually renders the page at 400px. This is an assumption, not verified.

No tests were weakened. Every check-site.sh commit only adds checks, and checks 1–8 from T-0009 are unchanged. No dependencies were added, and there is no package.json and no JS at all. The Google Fonts link loads Inter only, which the charter allows as 'the one family'.

Process note: T-0010 and T-0019 were parked by the same gate, 'new_tests_required but no test file changed'. T-0014 was parked on a 'revise' verdict, although the review excerpt shown finds no defect. All three were re-issued and merged as T-0018 and T-0020. This is a recurring gate problem, not a code-quality issue.
digest: A good day. All nine merges moved the site toward the charter, and the site check passes. The dark animated landing page is gone. The page is now light and set in Inter, with About, Selected work and Contact sections. Projects and contact links come from data files, so adding an entry means editing data, not writing markup. Accessibility work landed: one main heading, headings in order, visible focus outlines, and reduced-motion support that turns off all animation. The check script only gained new checks; none were removed or loosened. Nothing about Tim was made up. The About text and both project entries are clearly marked placeholders that he needs to fill in. Small loose ends: the old cat-cursor files are still in the repo but unused, the hero still has a slightly code-flavoured label, and the 400px no-horizontal-scroll result comes from a text search of the CSS, not an actual page render. Three tasks were parked before being redone, two of them by the same test-file gate, which looks worth tuning. Drift score 1 of 10, so the system keeps running.
